name: Two AR4 Cell
_comment: A station: the tree above the robots. It names which base robot packages the cell contains
and where each one stands, rather than describing any machine itself - that stays in the
package, so correcting the AR4 upstream corrects both arms here.
package and config are both resolved as an entry inside the station archive first, then as
a path relative to this file. A loose station like this one always takes the second route.
id names the folder an arm's own data lives in, and is deliberately not the same field as
name: renaming 'Left arm' must not orphan instances/left/config.json.
Placement is position_mm plus rotation_deg applied Rz(yaw) * Ry(pitch) * Rx(roll), with
rotation_deg given as [about X, about Y, about Z]. An explicit 12-value loc may be given
The scene is Y-up: Y is height, X and Z are the floor. Two arms standing on the same floor
therefore share a Y and are separated in X or Z, and turning one to face the other is the
middle number, a rotation about Y. This file used to separate them in Y and turn them about
Z, which stacked one of them 800mm above the other and stood it on its head.
A metre apart facing each other across the cell - about twice the AR4's reach, so each arm
can work without the other being in the way.
